name: Freddy's
disclaimer_extra: Freddy's publishes nutrition for finished items and for the things you add to them — cheese, bacon, sauces, custard mix-ins — but not for the bun, the bread or a patty on its own. Those appear on their allergen table with no figures. So this starts from a steakburger Freddy's sells and adds to it, rather than building one from the bun up. The patty is still visible in their own arithmetic: a Double Steakburger is 190 calories over a Single, and a Double Cheeseburger is 240 over a Single because the second patty brings a second slice of American cheese (50). Jalapeño Pepper Jack steps by 260, which is that same 190 plus its 70-calorie slice.
blurb: Start from a Freddy's steakburger, chicken sandwich or bowl and add the cheese, bacon and sauces — then build a concrete or shake from the custard menu and its mix-ins.

categories.name: Add to it
categories.note: Freddy's publishes the cheese, bacon and sauces on their own, so anything here can be added to a sandwich above. The bun is not published separately and is already inside every item's figure.
